description: This file defines abstract base classes and type aliases related to the dependency resolution process within pip's internal package resolution system. It includes a base class 'BaseResolver' with methods that should be overridden, and a type alias for a provider function.

classes.name: BaseResolver
classes.description: An abstract base class that outlines the interface for dependency resolution strategies within pip. It declares methods 'resolve' and 'get_installation_order' which should be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: RequirementSet resolve( self, root_reqs: List[InstallRequirement], check_supported_wheels: bool )
methods.description: Abstract method intended to resolve a list of root requirements into a RequirementSet, with support for checking wheel compatibility. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: List[InstallRequirement] get_installation_order( self, req_set: RequirementSet )
methods.description: Abstract method intended to return an ordered list of InstallRequirement objects representing the sequence of installations. Must be implemented by subclasses.
